title: Evidence:Gary Siders Jr. and Elizabeth Siders indicted on sexual-offense counts

data.claim: The Ohio Attorney General-origin August 21 announcement states that Gary Siders Jr. and Elizabeth Siders were each indicted on two counts of sexual battery (F3) and two counts of unlawful sexual conduct with a minor (F3).
data.notes: The protected minor is represented only as Minor Victim A when a research handle is necessary. No victim identity, age, kinship, address, school, medical, placement, image, social-account, or other re-identifying detail is retained.
